source_integrity.duplicate_code_result: Unique OOB SEL clock setter; UTC-offset setter and system/BMC time synchronization remain separate.

source_snapshot.procedure: Convert client date +%s to four LS-byte-first bytes, send 0x0A/0x49, then Get SEL Time; surrounding log clear.
source_snapshot.criteria: Command success and time set correctly.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL high-level sel time set; warns clock change.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Recognizes write risk but does not define time basis, sync ownership, drift or restoration.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Requires approved timestamp, exact little-endian readback, time-sync coordination, event chronology evidence and restore.
historical_reviews.history: Get time provides readback only; offset operation is distinct.
historical_reviews.v3_1: No clock write is authorized by Review and logs must remain intact.

original_test_intent: Set one approved SEL-device timestamp, verify precise readback and future timestamp interpretation, then restore the prior clock/synchronization state.
original_method: Send Storage 0x0A/0x49 with four little-endian seconds and verify using Get SEL Time.
manual_activity: Owner approves the exact timestamp/time basis, time-sync interruption, chronology impact and restoration window.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: High-level setter may hide exact bytes and does not resolve local/UTC semantics or recovery.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use protected raw 0x0A/0x49 with an approved four-byte value, exact 0x48 readback and controlled sync/restore.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Source encoding example, Script and timing preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture clock/offset/sync baseline, write one approved value, verify bounded drift and restore without deleting history.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces implicit client locale with approved semantics and adds synchronization/recovery control.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Readback alone does not prove event chronology or persistence under sync.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Changing SEL time can corrupt incident/warranty correlation and may be immediately overwritten.

project_override_considerations: A Redfish/vendor clock API is equivalent only if it changes the same SEL clock with identical time-basis, readback, chronology and restore evidence.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Title and raw setter align; local-time wording is underspecified but can be resolved by Project policy.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Setter semantics are identifiable; time basis/value/sync/recovery are readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Protects audit chronology by controlling time basis and synchronization and requiring restoration rather than log clearing.
independent_technical_reasoning: The numeric write may be valid while its interpretation is wrong if client locale, SEL offset and synchronization ownership differ. Acceptance therefore needs exact byte readback plus a bounded reference comparison, and any competing writer or chronology ambiguity is a stop condition rather than a retry trigger.

source_provenance.history: Exact-code and Get/Set time plus UTC-offset search
